newsitem.title: GERMANY: Karstadt puts off supervisory board meet.
newsitem.headline: Karstadt puts off supervisory board meet.

text.p: German retail group Karstadt AG said on Thursday is was postponing an extraordinary supervisory board meeting which had been called for this coming Saturday.

Responding to press speculation that chief executive Walter Deuss might be forced at the meeting to resign, the board said in a statement: "The public discussion set off by indiscretions would not allow the supervisory board to review important business questions with the required calm and depth."
